name: Swiggy Ltd.
business_summary: Hyperlocal commerce platform: food delivery, Instamart quick commerce, out-of-home dining (Dineout), supply chain/distribution (Scootsy) and other. TTM consolidated sales Rs 26,914 cr (+42%); operating loss Rs 2,904 cr (OPM -11%); Sep-26 quarter sales Rs 7,571 cr (+36%), net loss Rs 922 cr (Rs 791 cr in June), with Instamart loss reported at Rs 895 cr. Market cap Rs 52,156 cr at Rs 189, down 54% in 12 months, record low after Q2 on 2026-10-23 (-15% to -17%). Tencent exited via a Rs 982 cr block on 2026-10-30. FIIs fell from 14.6% to 8.9% and DIIs rose to 34.5% in Sept 2026 quarter; there is no promoter. Cash flow from operations was -Rs 2,898 cr in FY26, funded by a large equity raise (financing inflow Rs 9,397 cr).

revenue_mix.segment: out-of-home, supply chain, platform and other

exposures.mechanism: Instamart loss Rs 895 cr/qtr (~Rs 3,580 cr/yr). Competitor escalation +1 (Blinkit targets 3,500 dark stores by Mar-27 per Moneycontrol 2026-10-21; Flipkart Minutes overtook Instamart in dark-store count, Indian Retailer 2026-08-29) raises burn ~25% (Rs ~900 cr/yr) for ~2 years = Rs 1,800 cr = 3.5% of mcap, plus lower terminal share => -8. Stock fell ~16% on 2026-10-23 on this theme (Reuters/Bloomberg).
Faster category adoption expands TAM but shares it with better-capitalised rivals; net positive only if Instamart reaches contribution break-even. Judgemental +3 with wide range.

Food delivery and quick commerce are urban discretionary: +5pp urban growth -> +4pp GOV; at ~11% operating loss/revenue the operating leverage is large: +4pp x Rs 26,914 cr x 30% contribution margin = Rs 320 cr, ~1.5 years persistence => ~Rs 480 cr = 0.9% of mcap, scaled up for terminal-value effect => +4.
Cash-burning growth equity; value is long-duration. +25 bp repo -> -3% fair value, half transmitted => -1.5. Interest cost is Rs 218 cr TTM (leases).
Empirical -5.08/SSU (t=-1.5), not significant, shrunk to -2.5 for the global growth-style discount-rate effect.
Beta ~1.3; FIIs cut 14.59% -> 8.86% in two quarters and Tencent exited. +US$5 bn/qtr inflow reversal gives +3 beyond market effect.
+2pp food inflation raises menu prices/grocery basket and squeezes order frequency; ~1% of GOV => -1.

Gig-worker social-security contributions (1-2% of turnover capped at 5% of worker payouts, model knowledge of the Social Security Code) add ~0.6% of revenue (Rs ~160 cr/yr) = ~0.3% of mcap per year, capitalised ~3 years plus wage-inflation risk => -3. Timing of implementation unverified.
FSSAI moving to tighten the $80-bn online food market (Business Today 2026-10-13): licensing of dark stores and cloud kitchens raises compliance cost and risks suspensions.

Rider fuel costs feed into per-order payouts (~30% of costs): +10% Brent ~ +3% petrol/diesel retail effect (taxes dominate) => +0.3% of cost = Rs ~90 cr = 0.2% of mcap... scaled with persistence => -0.5 to -0.7. Empirical -0.73 (t=-0.7).
